answers.q1_what_did_you_play: Eager to Help first while Spark was still available, then Rapid Fire targeting Seapunk, then Duck and Cover.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered omitting Duck and Cover to preserve another energy for one of the two cards drawn by Eager to Help.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up one energy that could have been spent on a drawn card, potentially adding offense or another effect this turn.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If Seapunk had not telegraphed damage, I would have omitted Duck and Cover and kept that energy available for the cards drawn by Eager to Help.
